deterministic_extraction_limit: The fresh MinerU Flash output is not byte-identical to the retained unknown-provenance extraction and is locally noisier in several arrows, limits, indices, and map notations. Existing source-checked cards record source-faithful statements. Problem 3 is false as printed: for f identically 1, the displayed expression inside the outer limit equals n. Problem 11 as printed asks for the ordinary limit of log(det M_n); with D_n=det M_n one has D_n=a D_{n-1}+b^2 D_{n-2}, so D_n has exponential rate lambda_+=(a+sqrt(a^2+4b^2))/2 and log D_n is not generally a finite real limit (it tends to plus or minus infinity unless lambda_+=1).
